title: 第九课 · 你住在哪儿
subtitle: Lesson 9 — 你住在哪儿 · Where do you live?

items.py: Nǐ de diànhuà hàomǎ shì duōshao?
Wǒ de shǒujī hào shì yāo sān jiǔ líng yāo èr sān sì wǔ liù qī.

items.en: Which room number do you live in?

data.topic: 会话1 · Dialogue 1 (Where Do You Live?)

items.py: Dàwèi: Hézǐ, nǐ zhù zài nǎr?
items.en: David: Kazuko, where do you live?

items.zh: 和子：我住在留学生宿舍。
items.py: Hézǐ: Wǒ zhù zài liúxuéshēng sùshè.
items.en: Kazuko: I live in the international students' dormitory.

items.py: Dàwèi: Nǐ zhù jǐ hào fángjiān?

items.zh: 和子：三层三一五号。你也住在宿舍吗？
items.py: Hézǐ: Sān céng sān yāo wǔ hào. Nǐ yě zhù zài sùshè ma?
items.en: Kazuko: Room 315, third floor. Do you also live in the dorm?

items.zh: 大卫：不，我不住在宿舍。我住在中国朋友家。
items.py: Dàwèi: Bù, wǒ bú zhù zài sùshè. Wǒ zhù zài Zhōngguó péngyou jiā.
items.en: David: No, I don't live in the dorm. I live at a Chinese friend's home.

items.py: Hézǐ: Nǐ de dìzhǐ shì shénme?

items.zh: 玛丽：和子，你知道大卫的电话号码吗？
items.py: Mǎlì: Hézǐ, nǐ zhīdào Dàwèi de diànhuà hàomǎ ma?
items.en: Mary: Kazuko, do you know David's phone number?

items.zh: 和子：知道。他的电话号码是62753618。
items.py: Hézǐ: Zhīdào. Tā de diànhuà hàomǎ shì liù èr qī wǔ sān liù yāo bā.
items.en: Kazuko: Yes. His phone number is 62753618.

items.zh: 玛丽：他的手机号是多少？
items.py: Mǎlì: Tā de shǒujī hào shì duōshao?

items.zh: 和子：他的手机号我不知道。你给他打电话吧。
items.py: Hézǐ: Tā de shǒujī hào wǒ bù zhīdào. Nǐ gěi tā dǎ diànhuà ba.
items.en: Kazuko: I don't know his mobile number. Call him.

data.topic: 语法 · Grammar (在, 住在, 多少 vs 几)

items.en: I live in the dorm. (住在 = live at/in)

items.py: Wǒ zhù zài Zhōngguó péngyou jiā.
items.en: I live at a Chinese friend's home.
Teacher Wang is in the classroom. (在 = at/in)

items.py: Nǐ de diànhuà hàomǎ shì duōshao?
items.en: What's your phone number? (多少 for large/unknown numbers)
Which room number? (几 for small/expected numbers, usually <10)
Which floor do you live on? (几 for small number)
How many students does your school have? (多少 for large number)

items.zh: 你住在哪儿？我住在宿舍。
items.py: Nǐ zhù zài nǎr? Wǒ zhù zài sùshè.
items.en: Where do you live? I live in the dorm.

items.zh: 你住在哪儿？我住在学校。
items.py: Nǐ zhù zài nǎr? Wǒ zhù zài xuéxiào.
items.en: Where do you live? I live at the school.

items.zh: 你住在哪儿？我住在北京。
items.py: Nǐ zhù zài nǎr? Wǒ zhù zài Běijīng.
items.en: Where do you live? I live in Beijing.

items.zh: 你住在哪儿？我住在朋友家。
items.py: Nǐ zhù zài nǎr? Wǒ zhù zài péngyou jiā.
items.en: Where do you live? I live at a friend's home.

items.zh: 他住几号房间？他住三一五号。
items.py: Tā zhù jǐ hào fángjiān? Tā zhù sān yāo wǔ hào.
items.en: What room does he live in? Room 315.

items.py: Tā zhù jǐ céng? Tā zhù sì céng.
items.en: What floor does she live on? The fourth floor.

items.zh: 你的电话号码是多少？我的电话号码是62753618。
items.py: Nǐ de diànhuà hàomǎ shì duōshao? Wǒ de diànhuà hàomǎ shì liù èr qī wǔ sān liù yāo bā.
items.en: What's your phone number? My number is 62753618.

items.zh: 你给谁打电话？我给老师打电话。
items.py: Nǐ gěi shuí dǎ diànhuà? Wǒ gěi lǎoshī dǎ diànhuà.
items.en: Who are you calling? I'm calling the teacher.

items.zh: 你住在哪儿？我住在留学生宿舍。
items.py: Nǐ zhù zài nǎr? Wǒ zhù zài liúxuéshēng sùshè.
items.en: Where do you live? I live in the international students' dorm.

items.zh: 你住几号房间？我住二〇八号。
items.py: Nǐ zhù jǐ hào fángjiān? Wǒ zhù èr líng bā hào.
items.en: What room? I live in room 208.

items.zh: 你知道他的地址吗？不知道。
items.py: Nǐ zhīdào tā de dìzhǐ ma? Bù zhīdào.
items.en: Do you know his address? No, I don't.

items.zh: 他的手机号码是多少？他的手机号码是13812345678。
items.py: Tā de shǒujī hàomǎ shì duōshao? Tā de shǒujī hàomǎ shì yāo sān bā yāo èr sān sì wǔ liù qī bā.
items.en: What's his mobile number? His number is 13812345678.

items.zh: 你给谁打电话？我给朋友打电话。
items.py: Nǐ gěi shuí dǎ diànhuà? Wǒ gěi péngyou dǎ diànhuà.
items.en: Who are you calling? I'm calling a friend.

items.zh: 她住在这儿吗？不，她不住在这儿，她住在那儿。
items.py: Tā zhù zài zhèr ma? Bù, tā bú zhù zài zhèr, tā zhù zài nàr.
items.en: Does she live here? No, she doesn't live here, she lives there.

items.zh: 王兰住几层？王兰住五层。
items.py: Wáng Lán zhù jǐ céng? Wáng Lán zhù wǔ céng.
items.en: What floor does Wang Lan live on? Wang Lan lives on the fifth floor.

items.zh: 请给我你的电话号码。好，我的号码是82654321。
items.py: Qǐng gěi wǒ nǐ de diànhuà hàomǎ. Hǎo, wǒ de hàomǎ shì bā èr liù wǔ sì sān èr yāo.
items.en: Please give me your phone number. OK, my number is 82654321.
